en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a World War I–era soldiers' memorial. A life‑size bronze soldier in uniform stands on a rough stone pedestal, holding a flag and a rifle. The base of the monument is decorated with wreaths, ribbons and potted flowers. Behind the statue are trees and the walls and roof of nearby buildings. A short inscription with dates is carved into the stone base.
